item.title: ANT - economics (111526)
item.description: Hi Bren, this is the economics map for Anthropic, ticker A-N-T, initialized November fifteenth, twenty twenty-six, from the second amendment to the S-1. The bottom line: this is usage-based software sitting on top of a giant pile of committed compute. Margins look like software when demand outruns capacity, and like heavy infrastructure when capacity outruns demand. The constraint today is supply
